business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Brokerage of Ginned Raw Cotton and Synthetic Yarns

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (Republic of the Marshall Islands)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – Common Law corporate statute modeled on Delaware General Corporation Law and New York Business Corporation Law, combined with customary law and a U.S.-influenced constitutional framework under the Compact of Free Association
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: U.S.-RMI Compact of Free Association (1986, as amended 2003), Titles 1 and 2 covering trade, investment, and economic relations
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) between RMI and the United States (2003, entered into force 2015)
No comprehensive double taxation agreement exists with any major economy for non-resident entities deemed tax-exempt offshore enterprises

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (RMI), as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2022 (RMI), as amended; AML/CFT Regulations 2023; RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Beneficial Ownership Directives; RMI Registrar of Corporations UBO Register maintenance obligations under the AML/CFT Act; Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) related provisions under the Criminal Code

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Passport of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner and Subscriber
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in UBO's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the licensed RMI Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent consular officer in the UBO's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; for non-Apostille signatories, consular legalization at an RMI Honorary Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country corporate registry (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State, or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the home registry's competent authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming source of funds, bank account conduct, and shareholder standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank in the client's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized by bank officer; apostille not required if addressed directly to the RMI Registered Agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, and signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Consolidated List, and RMI domestic restrictive measures. Enhanced due diligence required for Politically Exposed Persons (foreign and domestic), immediate family members, and close associates; ongoing transaction monitoring and re-screening at minimum annually and upon new appointments under the AML/CFT Act 2022 and RMI FIU guidance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Corporate Registry Online System (access via licensed RMI registered agents under the Companies Registry of the Republic of the Marshall Islands)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official corporate legal language. Corporate names must be rendered in the Latin alphabet; numerals, ampersands, and standard punctuation are permitted. Names must be distinguishable from existing registered names and reserved names in the RMI Registrar's index. Non-Latin script rendering is not recognized for official corporate records; transliteration into English is required for all filings and register entries.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, a written request for reconsideration must be filed with the RMI Registrar of Corporations and a selected alternate name submitted simultaneously. If reconsideration is refused, the applicant may invoke the statutory appeal procedure before the High Court of the Marshall Islands under the administrative review provisions of the Associations Law. All appeals must be accompanied by fresh due diligence evidence, a legal submission on distinguishability, and payment of the applicable filing fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted – a non-resident business corporation must maintain a registered office in the Marshall Islands, which may be the physical address of the licensed registered agent in Majuro. No physical trading premises, warehouse, or local employees are required for a non-resident commission-based brokerage of raw cotton. The registered agent must be accessible during normal business hours and maintain the statutory corporate records, minute book, and share register at that address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – estimated annual probability below 5% for a tax-exempt non-resident entity. Unannounced on-site inspections are not routine; they are typically triggered by FIU risk alerts, sanctions list hits, adverse media coverage, suspicious transaction reports, or formal Registrar compliance audits.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name search and reservation fee (per name)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee under the Business Corporations Act 1990 fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Articles of Incorporation filing fee – Business Corporation with authorized capital of up to 1,000,000 shares
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory capital-based filing tariff published by the RMI Registrar

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office annual retainer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for non-resident corporations under RMI Corporate Registry practice

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille, and consular authentication processing per UBO bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign affairs registry / notarial authorities in the home jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official government apostille fees plus notarial service charges in the home jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO register setup, PEP and sanctions screening, and risk assessment compliance pack
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent / AML Compliance Officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for end-to-end UBO verification and ongoing AML/CFT obligations under the AML/CFT Act 2022

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government annual compliance and tax-exempt non-resident status registration fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Tax and Revenue Office / Registrar of Corporations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Annual government maintenance fee for non-resident domestic corporations under RMI revenue regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence opinion, corporate secretary setup, and board minutes preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional rate for non-resident corporation formation, AML review, and initial corporate governance documentation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier delivery, secure document transmission, and registry database verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International courier service and registry verification agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Actual disbursement plus prevailing market handling fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), the principal corporate statute of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, specifically the provisions governing the certificate of incorporation, registered office and agent, and directors and officers; read together with the Business License Act 1990 (as amended) for the mandatory annual operating license.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (corporate registry administered by International Registries, Inc. pursuant to a delegation agreement with the Registrar).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation (executed by the incorporator and filed with the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act 1990).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued or paid-up capital: the corporation may be capitalized with nominal or zero paid-in sums, and no escrow account or capital contribution is required at incorporation. Shares may be issued for any lawful consideration fixed by the Board of Directors, and the full authorized capital may remain unissued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation approves and ratifies its certificate of incorporation and bylaws; RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the share subscriptions of the initial shareholders and issues the authorized shares for lawful consideration as recorded in the share register; RESOLVED, that the registered office and registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands are adopted; RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed as initial officers: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each to serve until successors are elected; RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute raw cotton bale brokerage and sale agreements, and submit any statutory filings. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Corporate Registry e-portal (name reservation window).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application selecting a corporate name ending in 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an approved abbreviation. The name must be distinguishable from names already on the register. Upon approval, the Registrar issues a Name Reservation Certificate valid for 60 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusingly similar or contrary to law, file a revised name application or submit a written consent letter from the prior rights-holder and resubmit without additional penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Resident Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent licensed by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations (typically an IRI-authorized corporate services provider in Majuro).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent consent form designating a resident registered agent and confirming the physical registered office address in the Republic of the Marshall Islands where service of process may be accepted.
required_dossiers: Registered agent consent to act form
Identification documentation of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent withdraws or is disqualified, the Corporation must appoint a substitute agent within 30 days; failure to do so may result in administrative dissolution or certificate revocation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator, with submission through the Registrar's online filing portal or in person at the Registry in Majuro.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Certificate of Incorporation containing the corporate purpose clause, which expressly includes international brokerage and wholesale trading of ginned raw cotton and synthetic yarns, the principal registered office and agent, and the authorized capital structure (e.g., USD 50,000 divided into 50,000 common shares). The certificate must be signed by the incorporator and notarized or witnessed by a notary public or consular officer; bylaws may be adopted contemporaneously.
required_dossiers: Copy of the Name Reservation Certificate
Notarized passport copy of the incorporator
Power of attorney if filing is made through a nominee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect or query notice, the applicant may file a corrective amendment or certificate of correction within 14 days curing the non-compliance; unresolved defects are appealable to the High Court of the Marshall Islands.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Government Fees and Formal Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (fiscal section) and the Ministry of Finance revenue collection window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the statutory government incorporation fee of USD 300 (standard fee for authorized capital not exceeding 50,000 shares) by wire transfer or through the IRI client portal. Submit the executed Certificate of Incorporation together with the registered agent's consent and the payment receipt, and obtain a stamped acknowledgment of filing.
required_dossiers: Corporate filing cover sheet or checklist
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected for deficiency, the applicant may resubmit an amended certificate within 15 days of written notice; if the registry declines to accept the resubmission, the applicant may seek judicial review before the High Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and First Board Actions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Certificate Issuance Unit).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation, establishing the corporation's legal existence. Convene the first board meeting, or act by unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting, to adopt the bylaws, accept share subscriptions, appoint of officers, and ratify the registered office and agent. Record the proceedings in the corporate minute book and share ledger.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes or unanimous written consent
Initial share register and share certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation is not issued, verify and cure any outstanding name, capital, or agent deficiencies with the Registry and refile; obtain a written status letter from the Registry confirming the outcome.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business License Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the business license application on the prescribed form, pay the license fee calculated on projected gross receipts, and obtain the annual Business License before commencing trading operations. If local employees will be engaged, register the Corporation with the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
Projected revenue statement or base financial declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the license application is declined, the applicant may appeal to the Minister of Finance within 30 days, correcting any revenue declaration discrepancies or supplemental documentation requested by the Division.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business License Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License for International Wholesale Brokerage of Textile Raw Materials (Ginned Raw Cotton and Synthetic Yarns).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Registration Only. The corporate activity is administrative office-based international brokerage with no manufacturing or physical processing facility; no regulated point-source discharges or land disturbance are associated with the licensed activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the office-based brokerage model. Should the Corporation later establish a cotton bale storage or handling facility, the EPA will require compliance with the Environmental Protection Act 1984, including stormwater run-off controls, solid waste segregation, dust/particulate management, and prohibition of open burning; cotton bales must be stored off-ground on pallets to prevent contamination and pest harborage.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Majuro Fire and Rescue Services confirming exit routes, extinguishers, and emergency lighting; building occupancy and structural inspection certification from the RMI Public Works Inspectorate for the leased office premises; and workplace occupational safety clearance from the RMI Occupational Safety and Health Office covering general office conditions and sanitation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Administration (RTA), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; official e-services portal: https://eservices.mof.gov.mh (limited online functions; paper filing remains standard for non-resident entities)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Marshall Islands imposes no national income tax on non-resident domestic corporations and has no VAT/GST; therefore no statutory TIN or VAT ID is required. A foreign-owned non-resident Business Corporation (MH_BC) must simply: (i) maintain registration and good standing with the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act; (ii) file the annual corporate report; and (iii) obtain an annual business license only if physically carrying on business within the Marshall Islands. No tax identification number is issued absent an active local trading or customs activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists. Non-resident domestic corporations are statutorily excluded from Marshall Islands income tax under the Business Corporations Act and the Income Tax Act exemptions, and no entity-level or pass-through election can alter this status. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized because there is no corporate income tax or equivalent creditable tax regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT, GST, or sales and use tax; only element-specific import duties and limited excise-type levies apply at customs clearance)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — the Marshall Islands levies no turnover-based indirect tax; registration for VAT/GST does not exist. Customs import duties apply transaction-by-transaction at the port of entry and are not triggered by any turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — there is no real-time fiscal clearance system, API-based e-invoicing mandate, digital stamping, or fiscal data reporting requirement. Paper-based commercial invoicing and standard export/import documentation satisfy legal record-keeping requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — since no VAT/GST is imposed, there is no export VAT to zero-rate and no refund mechanism. Exports of raw cotton bales from the Marshall Islands are entirely outside any consumption tax net; customs duties are generally not levied on exported goods.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CEM Form or equivalent Marshall Islands Customs Entry Form)
Bill of Lading (issued by the ocean carrier for the cotton bale consignment)
Commercial Invoice describing ISIC 4620 raw ginned cotton bales
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment evidence for proceeds from the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT-related zero-rating clawback exists because no VAT is chargeable. However, false or fraudulent export declarations, misdescription of goods, or under-valuation for customs statistics or shipping registry purposes may attract penalties, seizure of goods, and monetary fines under the Marshall Islands Customs Act and related regulations. A non-resident business corporation engaging in sham substantive activities in the Marshall Islands risks loss of its non-resident tax-exempt classification upon administrative review, and any associated documentary fraud is subject to general anti-fraud criminal sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commission of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Ministry of Finance), the prudential supervisor under the Marshall Islands Banking Act 2002 (as amended). The RMI has no conventional central bank because the US Dollar is the sole legal tender; monetary, clearing and settlement conditions are therefore set de facto by the US Federal Reserve system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility. The RMI maintains no exchange-control regime, capital-administration framework, or repatriation licensing. Capital and current account transactions (equity injections, dividends, management fees, profit remittance, capital repatriation) are freely transferable without central-bank approval or conversion rationing. The only practical hurdles are clearing-side: US correspondent-bank de-risking, OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and FATCA/CRS disclosures. Because the BC is a non-resident tax-exempt corporation, profit remittances are not subject to RMI withholding or income tax.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or conversion requirements exist. There is no mandated timeline for repatriating export receipts, no minimum conversion ratio, and no obligation to sell foreign currency to any RMI instrumentality. Receipts from LC and documentary-collection drawings on raw cotton bale sales may be retained in USD offshore or transferred freely, subject to RMI AML/CFT record-keeping (5 years) and suspicious transaction reporting to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - limited to statutory development-finance transactions; not a general commercial-account bank

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-Medium. RMI has no domestic electronic-money-institution (EMI) licensing framework, and the Banking Commission does not supervise foreign EMIs. Commercial offshore EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) may technically hold valid home-jurisdiction licenses, but most decline RMI-domiciled offshore Business Corporations under de-risking policies. Use of such rails is permissible only as a pass-through settlement layer for niche corridors, with an executed EMI client-exit/consent letter, full FATCA/CRS self-certification and a documented decision that custody with an unlicensed RMI entity is avoided.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory. BOMI requires at least one director and any 25%-or-greater beneficial owner (or a single authorized signatory holding an executed power of attorney) to appear in person at the Majuro or Ebeye branch for a KYC interview; fully remote onboarding for non-resident directors is not made available to offshore BCA entities. The file must include original notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, registered-agent acknowledgment from the Majuro registered agent, certified board resolutions, passport copies, source-of-wealth statements, and a signed relationship mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident offshore BCA with nominee registered-agent directors and no apparent economic substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Economic substance and corporate-file package: certificate of incorporation, good standing, registered-agent letter, current shareholders' register to ultimate natural persons, audited financial statements (or CPA-packaged SOF letter), Majuro registered-office confirmation, board resolutions in favour of the account, and an annual substance certification under RMI Economic Substance Rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Raw-cotton trade corridor raising trade-based money laundering (TBML) concerns through invoice mismatches, round-tripping or unverified brokers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full trade-chain dossier per transaction: signed sale/purchase contracts, UCP600-compliant drafts, original B/L, warehouse receipts, independent quality surveys (e.g., Cotlook/HVI certificate), packing lists, insurance certificates, three-way invoice-B/L-payment matching, and counterparty profile reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATCA/CRS classification mismatch or opacity of UBO identity for a US-style Business Corporation domiciled in a treaty-light offshore jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed W-8BEN-E / CRS self-certification, certified UBO declaration with notarized passports and POAs, organizational-structure chart to ultimate beneficial owners, sanctions-screening reports for all counterparties, and a four-eye-review account file refreshed at each material change.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for equity injection: board resolution, executed subscription agreement and updated register of shareholders; the parent or UBO transmits USD by SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 cover) through a US correspondent bank for credit to MH_BC's BOMI operational account, with remittance details reading 'Capital Contribution - RMI Business Corporation MH_BC'. RMI imposes no FX purpose-code or permit requirement, but BOMI requires source-of-funds clearance against the EDD file for each tranche above USD 250,000; final booking is made to paid-in capital and the full trail is retained for 5 years for FIU inspection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: All disbursements settle in USD only. Pre-export supplier settlements use direct SWIFT MT103 credits to the seller's bank with granular remittance information; high-value raw-cotton purchases are funded by irrevocable at-sight SWIFT MT700 Letters of Credit confirmed by a Hong Kong or Singapore AAA bank, incorporating UCP600, ISBP 745 and Incoterms 2020 rules; documentary collections (D/P and D/A) are routed through the collecting bank with original B/L and warehouse receipts couriered in the documentary set; ACH and cash rails are prohibited for cross-border trade, and invoice amounts must remain net of any intermediate bank charges to avoid TBML scrutiny.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla forward contracts on non-USD settlement legs (executed with licensed non-resident banks; no RMI onshore approval needed)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on emerging-market currencies (e.g., PKR, BDT, UZS) to hedge cotton offtaker payment exposure
Cross-currency swaps under ISDA 2002 master agreements with licensed non-resident counterparties (net-settled, offshore execution)
Commodity-linked economic hedges on ICE Cotton No. 2 limited to non-speculative treasury policy cover

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report under the Business Corporations Act (Registrar of Corporations form)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of US$200 or 10% of the annual fee, whichever is greater; continued non-payment or non-filing for 2 consecutive years may trigger administrative strike-off and dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate License Fee Renewal (franchise-type renewal payment for non-resident business corporation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable simultaneously with the Annual Report, within 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late penalty of 10% of the unpaid renewal fee; willful non-payment for 2 consecutive years exposes the entity to administrative strike-off and loss of separate legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Confirmation and Beneficial Ownership Data Refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registered Agent (RAIC system); no public UBO register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the Annual Report cycle; registered agent must complete CDD refresh by the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain current UBO and registered agent details may suspend RAIC electronic filing privileges and subject the entity to a notice of non-compliance; repeated breach may lead to involuntary administrative dissolution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act of the Marshall Islands. There are no revenue, asset, or share-capital thresholds that trigger a mandatory independent audit; an audit may be imposed by the articles of incorporation, by shareholder agreement, or by court order.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: RMI has no local statutory GAAP. Books and records may be maintained under IFRS as issued by the IASB or under US GAAP; non-resident business corporations are not required to file financial statements with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial ownership information is kept by the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent under the Registered Agent Regulations. The agent must conduct a risk-based CDD refresh at least annually, confirm each indirect owner and controller, and update its internal register. There is no public UBO filing with the Registrar. Any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership must be communicated to the registered agent immediately upon execution, and the updated register must be attested by the agent before the next anniversary.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$3,000 - US$8,000 per year (only if independently engaged)

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for Non-Resident Business Corporations; nominal 8% gross-income rate under MIRC Title 54 (Income Tax Act) is fully exempt for non-resident BCs by the Income Tax (Exemption) Regulations and BCA § 79
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax for non-resident BCs; only recurring cost is the annual franchise tax/registration fee (USD 150–USD 1,800 depending on authorized capital); no statutory license fee for cotton brokerage ISIC 4620
